title: Product and Research Operations Manager, Voices
description:
ABOUT CARTESIA

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product and Research Operations Manager to run the operational backbone of Cartesia's Voice function - supporting voice production for customers, talent sourcing and logistics, and voice delivery for Go-To-Market and Customer Success. You'll work directly alongside our Voice Production Lead and Voice Library Lead, and provide hands-on support across their respective work-streams.

Part of your time will go toward cross-functional ad-hoc operations, including supporting growth initiatives.

YOUR IMPACT

- Voice Production & Library - Support execution of voice production runs alongside the Voice Production Lead. Over time, you'll own day-to-day production and library health reporting, take on more locales and volume, and build automations to streamline the process.

- Sourcing & Talent logistics - Support voice sourcing alongside the Voice Library Lead. Build the systems to source, vet, and create voices for the voice library with voice acting talent as well as vendors.

- Customer Voice Delivery & Enablement - Own customer-facing voice engagements end to end, driving customers to be successful with our models. Drive voice-related GTM enablement.

- Ad-hoc Strategy and Growth Projects - Support ad-hoc strategy & operations work, especially around our modeling products for TTS, STT, and other bets. Support Cartesia’s growth in international markets on a project by project basis.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 3 - 6 years as an operator at a high-growth tech startup or in strategy consulting (MBB or similar)

- High agency - a proactive self-starter who can operate autonomously to get things done in ambiguous environments

- Customer-facing chops, with the ability to drive conversations with executives

- Semi-technical - comfortable using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, etc to build lightweight systems, and understands core concepts of system design

- Genuine interest in operating with founder-level hunger, and real enthusiasm for voice and audio technology - you have opinions on it, not just interest

What makes a strong candidate:

- Experience in the AI industry, especially in AI Strategy and Operations or Product Operations roles

- A track record of going out of your way to get things done proactively

- Builds lightweight systems autonomously

- Detail-oriented under volume; maintains attention to detail even with large volume of tasks

- Credible in front of GTM teams and customers without needing a lead in the room

MORE DETAILS

🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

Total Rewards & Market Analysis

Advisory & Stakeholder Partnership

Execution & Integration

· Coordinate closely with HR Operations, Payroll, and related teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation

· Provide project management support for Total Rewards activities across the M&A lifecycle, ensuring seamless execution and issue resolution
Broader Compensation Support

Minimum Qualifications 

• Experience in Total Rewards, Compensation, and/or M&A related HR work

• 5+ years of experience supporting M&A transactions, integration, compensation, or workforce-related initiatives

O foco da posição é implementar e configurar a ferramenta Ping AIC, desenvolver scripts, realizar troubleshooting e construir integrações de identidade, especialmente aquelas que exigem customizações além dos recursos nativos (out-of-the-box) do produto.

• Construir, configurar e homologar o ambiente da plataforma Ping AIC. Testar as integrações do Ping AIC com aplicações e plataformas corporativas do cliente e seus parceiros.

• Garantir a operação contínua, estabilidade, manutenção evolutiva e suporte de nível avançado das integrações após a entrada em produção (Go-Live).

• Implementar e realizar troubleshooting de jornadas adaptativas de onboarding, login passwordless, MFA, SSO, recuperação de conta segura e gestão de organizações por meio de administração delegada.

• Investigar e resolver problemas complexos de integração envolvendo a plataforma de IAM, aplicações e sistemas integrados.

• Construir e sustentar integrações customizadas e fora do padrão nos cenários em que os recursos nativos da plataforma não forem suficientes.

• Atuar em contato direto e contínuo com os times de Segurança, IAM, Aplicações e Infraestrutura do cliente para levantar requisitos, implementar soluções e apoiar a operação.

• Apoiar os arquitetos no desenho de integrações mais complexas durante a implementação, realizando validações técnicas práticas e prototipação.

• Elaborar e manter atualizadas as documentações técnicas (As-Built) e os procedimentos operacionais (Runbooks) fundamentais para a transição e execução da fase de sustentação.

• 5+ anos de experiência prática trabalhando na implementação e sustentação de soluções corporativas de IAM / CIAM de larga escala (ex: Ping Identity, ForgeRock, Okta, Auth0, Microsoft Entra ID, Keycloak, CyberArk ou similares).

• 3+ anos de sólido conhecimento em conceitos de CIAM, autenticação adaptativa, autorização granular (RBAC/ABAC), SSO, MFA e fluxos passwordless (WebAuthn/FIDO2/Passkeys).

• 3+ anos de experiência na construção e manutenção de jornadas/árvores de autenticação, orquestração de identidade e integração com canais Web e Mobile (via APIs e SDKs).

• 3+ anos de experiência prática com APIs REST, desenvolvimento de scripts (ex: JavaScript, Groovy, Python), manipulação de payloads/tokens (JWT/JWS/JWKS) e integrações com sistemas de backend.

• Conhecimento prático consolidado nos protocolos OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) e SAML 2.0.

Qualificações Desejáveis (Diferenciais)

• Experiência prática com PingOne Advanced Identity CloudExperiência com perfis de segurança financeira e padrões avançados de OAuth: FAPI 2.0, PAR, RAR, mTLS, JWK PoP e Dynamic Client Registration (DCR / RFC 7591).

• Habilidades de diagnóstico e troubleshooting fim a fim (aplicação, gateway, plataforma de identidade e sistemas downstream).

title: Vice President of Strategy
locationText: Remote; Washington, D.C. or Los Angeles preferred
description:
Thank you for considering Oklo. We are hiring a Vice President of Strategy to build and lead our corporate Strategy function.

Position Description

Oklo is seeking a Vice President of Strategy to serve as the senior leader of the company’s corporate strategy function. Reporting to the Chief Strategy Officer, you will shape Oklo’s enterprise strategy, lead the Strategy team, and help the company make and execute its most consequential decisions.

The function is designed to be proactive and high leverage: identifying emerging opportunities and risks, developing independent points of view, and deploying a focused team against the company’s highest-priority questions and initiatives. You will set the function’s agenda and standards, determine where Strategy resources can have the greatest impact, and lead work from early thesis development through executive decision, execution, and handoff.

You will work directly with the founders, CFO, and business-unit leaders, bringing forward original recommendations, constructively challenging assumptions, and leading the Strategy function’s contribution to executive and Board decisions. You will be accountable for the quality of company-level strategy, the effectiveness of the Strategy function, and the impact of the initiatives it leads.

Specific responsibilities include:

• Build and lead the corporate strategy function. Design the function's operating model; hire, develop, and manage talent; allocate resources; and own the standards, quality, and results of the team.

• Own enterprise strategy. Lead the development and refinement of Oklo's long-range strategy, including portfolio choices, priority markets, business models, growth platforms, and the allocation of leadership attention and company resources.

• Set a proactive strategic agenda. Identify important opportunities, risks, and unanswered questions before they are formally assigned. Sponsor the right analysis and recommend what the company should pursue, defer, reshape, or decline.

• Lead strategic planning and performance reviews. Own the Strategy team's delivery of annual and multi-year planning, objectives and key results, scorecards, and initiative reviews.

• Shape major corporate choices. Support the strategic evaluation of partnerships, creative capital initiatives, acquisitions, new ventures, international opportunities, and structural options in collaboration with the relevant business units and functional owners.

• Own the strategic-initiative portfolio. Establish objectives, accountable leaders, milestones, decision points, and review mechanisms. Recommend when to advance, resource, redirect, stop, or hand off work.

• Advise executive leadership and the Board. Bring independent, evidence-based recommendations; challenge assumptions constructively; frame alternatives and tradeoffs; and lead consequential strategic discussions.

• Personally lead selected high-stakes initiatives. Take direct responsibility for a small number of the company's most important initiatives through decision, launch, transaction, or a clear operational handoff.

• Integrate strategy across the company. Partner with Finance, Corporate Development, Strategic Partnerships, Legal, Government Affairs, international teams, technical and regulatory leaders, and business units so company-level choices remain coherent through execution.

• Build company-wide strategy capability. Establish rigorous methods for business cases, decision memos, portfolio reviews, and strategic planning, and coach colleagues to improve the quality and speed of decision-making.

Minimum Qualifications

• Senior leadership experience. Substantial experience leading corporate strategy, general management, business building, or a comparable enterprise mandate, with a record of shaping company direction and driving implementation.

•
End-to-End Delivery: Own a product area from problem definition to shipped outcome. Author PRDs, obtain engineering and QE sign-offs, and record the go-live decision.

Roadmap & Prioritization: Manage and defend the quarterly roadmap for your product area. Priority requests are scored using RICE-no side doors or line-jumping.

•
Quality Standard: Drive quality jointly with Quality Engineering. Ensure acceptance criteria are met before shipping-never ship on hope.

•
Cross-Functional Command: Lead weekly PO checkpoints, executive recaps, and customer calls. Speak confidently for your product without waiting for direction.

0-to-1 Experience: Proven track record taking a product from concept to launch. You owned the bet, the scope, and the outcome.

•
Startup Grit: 5+ years of experience in startup or high-growth SaaS environments. You excel in navigating ambiguity and finishing process frameworks.

•
Staff-Level Scope: Track record of multi-team influence, driving outcomes over output, and solving ambiguous problem spaces.

•
AI-First Execution: You actively utilize AI tools for research, drafting PRDs, synthesizing customer calls, and prototyping.

•
Clear Documentation: Exceptional writing skills. Your PRDs allow engineering and QA to build and test without extra decode meetings.

•
B2B SaaS Background: Experience in tax, accounting, professional services, or complex workflow automation software is a plus.

How We Work

•
PRD Standard: No epic enters a sprint without an approved PRD (PO, Engineering Lead, QE).

•
Single Source of Truth: One quarterly roadmap, strict RICE scoring, no side doors.

•
Locked Sprints: Locked sprint scope, live demos during sprint reviews, and accurate release notes.

•
Data-Driven Go-Live: Go-live decisions are recorded against PRD acceptance criteria with evidence.

- You own your domain with confidence, Engineering, Design, and Go-to-Market trust your judgement and come to you first

description:

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. NVIDIA 's Advanced Package Engineering team sits at the intersection of cutting-edge chip design and the physical reality of getting silicon to product - and we're expanding it. As AI systems grow more complex, NVIDIA 's multi-die packages have become some of the most challenging engineered products, connecting dozens of chiplets across substrates, interposers, and heterogeneous interfaces. The engineers who build the automation infrastructure for these packages don't just write software - they directly determine whether NVIDIA can tape out on schedule and at scale. This role is a rare opportunity to craft production-grade EDA tooling that operates at the bleeding edge of packaging technology, where no commercial solution exists yet and the problems you solve become the new industry baseline. If you want develop design flows for NVIDIA 's next-generation AI and HPC platform packages, this is that job.

title: Head of Developer Relations

title: [Flexible & Remote] Relocation Consultant, APAC
description:
Hello! 🦜

Thanks for checking out our job posting. You’ve already taken a tiny step towards being a part of our team - huzzah!

We know that taking your next career step is as exciting as it can be exhausting. So, with that in mind, we’ve tried to keep our description simple and cliché-free to help you decide if PerchPeek and this role are a good match for you.

About PerchPeek

At PerchPeek we dream of a borderless world where people have the freedom to live and work where they please. Where ideas and resources flow where they’re most needed unrestricted by national borders. We strive to create a world of opportunity for anyone, anywhere - one move at a time .

Have you ever relocated? If so, you probably know how overwhelming it can be-immigration hoops, tax implications, housing, shipping, utilities, banking…the list goes on. No matter where in the world you go, relocating is complicated, time-intensive, and stressful. PerchPeek was conceived to change that.

We’re building a streamlined Mobility ecosystem to empower businesses and individuals to move anywhere in the world. We support employers and employees through every stage of the relocation process, providing an affordable, scalable, high-value service, powered by technology and relocation expertise.

About the role

Flexible Relocation Coaches work with PerchPeek to support current markets with surges in business volume, provide flexibility for Relocation Coach capacity, and improve coverage to support relocators across multiple markets and timezones. This role will work within a network of third-party consultants and with PerchPeek ’s Network Manager to deliver quality customer experience in line with customer requirements and PerchPeek ’s SLAs for quality and productivity.

Previous experience in the Global Mobility / Relocation industry and knowledge of relocation management and/or destination services is helpful, but not essential , as we’ll provide a free training course on how to become a successful Flex Relocation Coach. You’ll also receive paid training on all of our internal systems. You might be an awesome Relocation Coach if you’ve previously worked as a Customer Success Manager, Concierge, Personal Assistant, Support or Operations Specialist, or if you’ve worked in industries like travel, hospitality, SaaS startups, or HR.

Scope of Work

In more detail, Flexible Relocation Coaches will be contracted to deliver end-to-end Relocation Coach services to a diverse portfolio of relocators by:

• Building trusted relationships with relocators over the duration of their relocation journey as their main point of contact, delegating tasks when appropriate.

• Communicating with relocators via a) the PerchPeek app and b) through consultative and supportive calls to understand the customer’s needs, explain relocation services, and provide expertise, guidance & support to relocators within your portfolio.

• Handling difficult or complex relocator enquiries or situations, using critical judgement to ensure the best outcomes for your movers, including escalating these as appropriate.

• Providing the “right expertise at the right time” on all aspects of the relocation journey and life in the destination country to equip relocators to integrate successfully to their new location.

• Supporting relocators in understanding and abiding to their company’s relocation policy, including management of their relocation allowances.

• Recommending and coordinating additional relocation services from providers, working within PerchPeek ’s Supply Chain. Examples include immigration, tax or shipping providers.

• Systems Cleanliness: utilising Operations and Relocation Experience processes to the highest standards to help make sure that our teams and systems run smoothly. i.e. ensuring collected data is accurate and useful for data analysis, reporting, and insights.

• Process implementation: supporting the rollout of process improvements by engaging with new processes and tools.

title: Medical Director National OP Medicare
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Medical Director relies on medical background and reviews preauthorization requests for services. The Medical Director work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. The Medical Director actively uses their medical background, experience, and judgement to make determinations whether requested services, requested level of care, and/or requested site of service should be authorized. All work occurs with a context of regulatory compliance, and work is assisted by diverse resources which may include national clinical guidelines, CMS policies and determinations, clinical reference materials, internal teaching conferences, and other sources of expertise. Medical Directors will learn Medicare and Medicare Advantage requirements and will understand how to operationalize this knowledge in their daily work.

The Medical Director’s work includes computer-based review of moderately complex to complex clinical scenarios, review of all submitted clinical records, prioritization of daily work, communication of decisions to internal associates, and possible participation in care management. The clinical scenarios predominantly arise from inpatient or post-acute care environments. Has discussions with external physicians by phone to gather additional clinical information or discuss determinations regularly, and in some instances, these may require conflict resolution skills. Some roles include an overview of coding practices and clinical documentation, grievance and appeals processes, and outpatient services and equipment, within their scope.

The ideal candidate supports and collaborates with other team members, other departments, Humana colleagues and the Regional VP Health Services. • Advanced degree such as an MBA, MHA, MPH

title: Medical Courier - Evansville, IN
description:
Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.  

Airspace has been rated one of  America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of  CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m. 

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics. 

 

Job Summary
Airspace is seeking professional, dependable drivers to support our dedicated medical delivery routes. This role plays a critical part in ensuring surgical equipment arrives safely and on time to hospitals and surgical centers. Our drivers directly support procedures such as orthopedic and joint replacement surgeries by transporting essential medical kits between facilities.

If you are reliable, detail-oriented, and understand the importance of time-sensitive healthcare logistics, this opportunity is for you.

Responsibilities

• Transport surgical kits from a designated warehouse to hospitals and surgical facilities

• Deliver to Sterile Processing Departments, Implant Rooms, or approved vendor storage areas

• Retrieve equipment following procedures and return to the warehouse

• Utilize the Airspace mobile platform for real-time tracking and communication

• Maintain professional interactions with hospital staff and warehouse personnel

• Ensure accuracy, timeliness, and proper handling of all equipment

Requirements

• Must own a high-top cargo van  (2015 or newer, clean and well-maintained)

• Valid driver’s license, current insurance, and vehicle registration

• Prior medical courier experience strongly preferred (experience with medical devices is a plus)

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs

• Comfortable using mobile applications and technology

• Strong communication skills and dependable work ethic

Full-time, contract-based opportunity
Core Values:

• We are One Team . We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.

• We make an Impact . We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.

• We are Passionate . We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.

title: Software Engineer, Web Infrastructure
description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Web Infrastructure builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients so product engineers can ship fast, reliable, accessible experiences. As a junior engineer on the team, you’ll help make those experiences measurably faster and more resilient. You’ll investigate performance bottlenecks, improve how the client loads and responds, and help build tools that catch regressions earlier. You don’t need to arrive as a performance expert; we’re looking for strong fundamentals, curiosity, and a desire to learn by shipping useful work.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

- Use browser tools and real-world data to investigate page-load and interaction bottlenecks, then turn findings into focused improvements.

- Help build or improve performance tests, dashboards, and guardrails that make regressions easier to catch during development and rollout.

- Ship scoped improvements to client loading, rendering, asset delivery, or caching, measuring their impact and checking for regressions.

- Partner with Web Infrastructure and product engineers to land changes safely across Notion’s web clients.

- Document what you learn and share clear recommendations so teams can make better performance tradeoffs.

SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

- Solid programming fundamentals and some experience building software with JavaScript or TypeScript; familiarity with React or another component-based UI framework is helpful.

- Curiosity about how browsers work and how code affects page load, rendering, and interaction responsiveness.

- A thoughtful debugging approach: you can break a problem down, gather evidence, and ask for help when you’re stuck.

- Clear, kind communication and an interest in collaborating across teams.

- Intellectual curiosity about AI-enabled engineering tools; you use them thoughtfully and review their output critically.

Experience with performance profiling, browser developer tools, React profiling, bundlers, code splitting, service workers, asset caching, or performance testing is a plus-not a prerequisite. We welcome candidates who are excited about the work even if they don’t match every bullet.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.

Become a part of our caring community

About Humana
Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 50 healthcare company with a long history of successful innovation and reinvention. Over its history, Humana has evolved from nursing homes, to hospitals, to health insurance, and today is a leader in consumer-focused health solutions and one of the largest health benefits organizations in the country.

About the Team
The Supplemental Benefits team delivers and oversees some of the most visible and valued benefits that Humana 's Medicare Advantage members receive. These benefits extend beyond traditional medical coverage and include dental, vision, hearing, over-the-counter health and wellness products, fitness, transportation, meals, in-home support, connectivity, and other services that help members maintain their health, independence, and quality of life.

We design, launch, and manage a diverse portfolio of supplemental benefits reaching millions of members. Our work sits at the intersection of product strategy, vendor partnership, data and analytics, operational execution, member experience and compliance.

This is a team where the work is unusually tangible and high impact. The decisions made here can influence how millions of Medicare Advantage members access dental care, obtain needed hearing support, get to a medical appointment, remain safely and independently at home, or stay connected to their care team. We partner with leaders across the enterprise and with external organizations that deliver these benefits at scale.

As the portfolio grows in size, complexity, and importance, we are building the shared capabilities needed to manage it consistently and at scale - including a dedicated strategy and transformation capability focused on the portfolio's highest-priority opportunities and most complex challenges. Role Overview
The Director, Supplemental Benefits Strategy & Transformation will build and lead a new team responsible for strategy, transformation, and complex cross-portfolio initiatives across Humana 's Supplemental Benefits organization.

This leader will serve as a senior thought and execution partner to Supplemental Benefits leadership, bringing structure and momentum to the organization's most complex and ambiguous priorities and initiatives. Initiatives will span multiple benefits, vendors, and enterprise functions and include vendor strategy and optimization, operating model transformation, implementation capability, regulatory response, portfolio analytics, governance, and emerging strategic opportunities.

Success will require the Director to translate strategic, regulatory, financial, operational, and member-experience considerations into clear recommendations, executable roadmaps, defined ownership, and measurable outcomes - accountable not only for developing recommendations, but for mobilizing stakeholders and driving initiatives through implementation and adoption. Example projects could include reimagining how a multi-million-dollar vendor relationship is structured and governed, designing the operating model for a new benefit reaching millions of members, or building the analytics capability that allows leaders to see portfolio performance clearly. The common thread is work that is consequential, cross-functional, visible to Humana 's senior leaders, and improves the daily lives of millions of Medicare Advantage members.

A defining principle of the role is that the team builds and transitions rather than builds and holds. Once a capability, process, or governance routine is designed, implemented, and stabilized, the Director is responsible for transitioning it to Shared Services Operations, benefit owners, or other appropriate teams for ongoing execution - preserving the team's capacity for the next set of high-value problems.

• Previous experience in the insurance industry, particularly Personal Lines insurance.

• Familiarity with auto and home insurance policies, endorsements, and policy servicing.

• Experience handling vehicle or driver additions and removals, policy changes, and insurance quotations.

- Run MBRs/QBRs with top partners against shared goals, and prune the partners who aren't producing

BE THE VOICE OF THE CHANNEL INTERNALLY

- Partner with Sales leadership so channel-sourced deals are worked, tracked, and credited cleanly

BUILD THE OPERATING SYSTEM

- Stand up the infrastructure that makes the channel scale: partner CRM hygiene, referral attribution, pipeline tracking, and a partner portal experience

- Document the playbook - partner onboarding, referral handoff, enablement, and event workflows - so the next hires ramp fast

- Produce clear, regular reporting on channel-sourced pipeline and revenue for leadership
